items.prompt: In Helmet you spell words of three or more letters through touching tiles: across, down or diagonal, and words can bend.
Every Helmet site has 48 tiles and can always be cleared completely. Your score is tiles cleared, then your time.
Spell a word and the crane lifts it away. Everything above it falls, so think about what drops and where it lands.
Mind the dynamite. It goes off when it falls or when something lands on it, clearing the 3 by 3 around it.
A girder holds up everything on it. Take away what is holding it up and the crane whisks it off, and everything on it falls.
GuffBot in his hard hat can be any letter. Save him for the word you cannot quite finish.
Before you press Go, the bar tells you how many tiles that word will clear.
Undo is there in Helmet, but each one costs 15 seconds on your time.
If the site can no longer be cleared completely, the beacon turns red. Undo, or keep going for points.
Stuck on a Helmet site? Pause for a while and a clue may appear.
A new Helmet site goes up every day at midnight UK time, the same for everyone.
Three-letter words count in Helmet, and a short word in the right place can set off the dynamite.
